_comment: Federal return due dates by entity type, as offsets from the end of the tax year, read from each return's own IRS instructions on 2026-10-07. A due date that lands on a weekend or legal holiday moves to the next business day (IRC 7503; see legal_holidays.json). The dashboard countdown tiles and the client calendar both read this file; nothing in the UI restates a date. 'day' is 15 or 'last' (last day of the month). Offsets are calendar months after the tax year ends.

entity_types.label: Individual
entity_types.source_citation: IRS, 'When to file': calendar-year filers April 15; fiscal-year filers day 15 of the fourth month after the year ends. Form 4868: automatic 6-month extension (to October 15).

entity_types.label: C corporation

exceptions.note: A June 30 year end beginning before 1 Jan 2026 is due on the 15th day of the 3rd month, with a 7-month extension. For tax years beginning in 2026 the general rule (4th month, 6-month extension) applies.
exceptions.source_citation: Form 1120 instructions, When To File (June 30 year end: 15th day of the 3rd month); Form 7004 instructions, Extension Period (June 30 year ends beginning before 1 Jan 2026: 7 months; tax years beginning in 2026: 6 months).

entity_types.source_citation: Form 1120 instructions, When To File: 15th day of the 4th month after the end of the tax year. Form 7004 instructions: automatic extension generally 6 months.

entity_types.label: S corporation
entity_types.source_citation: Form 1120-S instructions, When To File: 15th day of the 3rd month after the end of the tax year. Form 7004 instructions: automatic extension generally 6 months.

entity_types.label: Partnership
entity_types.source_citation: Form 1065 instructions, When To File: 15th day of the 3rd month following the end of the tax year (March 15 for calendar year). Form 7004 instructions: automatic extension generally 6 months.

entity_types.label: Trust or estate
entity_types.source_citation: Form 1041 instructions, When To File: calendar year April 15; fiscal year 15th day of the 4th month. Form 7004 instructions: estates (other than bankruptcy estates) and trusts get an automatic 5½-month extension (September 30 for a calendar year).

entity_types.label: Exempt organization
entity_types.source_citation: Form 990 instructions, When To File: 15th day of the 5th month after the accounting period ends (May 15 for calendar year). Form 8868 instructions: automatic 6-month extension.

countdown_tiles.label: March 15
countdown_tiles.represents: Calendar-year S corporation and partnership returns (Forms 1120-S and 1065), or their extensions

countdown_tiles.label: April 15
countdown_tiles.represents: Individual and calendar-year C corporation returns (Forms 1040 and 1120), or their extensions

countdown_tiles.label: September 15
countdown_tiles.represents: Extended calendar-year S corporation and partnership returns

countdown_tiles.label: October 15
countdown_tiles.represents: Extended individual returns (and extended calendar-year C corporation returns)

countdown_note: These are the commonly applied calendar-year dates. The exact obligation depends on the entity type, its tax year and any extension filed; a date on a weekend or legal holiday moves to the next business day.
